name: io.github.maxf98/github
title: GitHub
description: GitHub's hosted MCP server: repos, issues and PRs. Needs a personal access token.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: GitHub personal access token, sent as `Bearer <token>`.

notes: GitHub's hosted server has no dynamic client registration and its built-in OAuth is reserved for first-party clients (Copilot/VS Code), so we take a user-supplied PAT as the Bearer token instead.
